title: Anonymous git clone/fetch from gitlab.com
why: git over https with no credentials is an unauthenticated gitlab.com request.
fix: Put a token in the URL (oauth2:${GITLAB_TOKEN}@gitlab.com), use SSH (git@gitlab.com:), or point it at the Codeberg mirror.

title: pip git+https dependency on gitlab.com
why: pip runs git clone against gitlab.com with no credentials on every cold install.
fix: git+https://oauth2:${GITLAB_TOKEN}@gitlab.com/... (pip expands ${VAR} in requirements files) or git+https://codeberg.org/...

title: npm dependency fetched from gitlab.com
why: gitlab:owner/repo and git+https://gitlab.com deps are fetched from gitlab.com without credentials; package.json cannot expand a token.

title: Go modules fetched direct from gitlab.com
why: GOPROXY=direct, or GOPRIVATE/GONOPROXY covering gitlab.com, makes the go command clone gitlab.com modules itself, from your IP, without credentials unless .netrc is set.
fix: GOPROXY=https://proxy.golang.org,direct for public modules; for private ones write .netrc: machine gitlab.com login oauth2 password ${GITLAB_TOKEN}

title: Go module path on gitlab.com
why: Map entry: with the default GOPROXY the module comes through proxy.golang.org, so your IP is not the one counted.
fix: If you mirror it to Codeberg: replace gitlab.com/owner/repo => codeberg.org/owner/repo vX.Y.Z

title: Unauthenticated gitlab.com API call
why: A /api/v4 call with no PRIVATE-TOKEN, JOB-TOKEN or Authorization header counts against the anonymous allowance.
fix: curl --header "PRIVATE-TOKEN: ${GITLAB_TOKEN}" ... or the Forgejo API at https://codeberg.org/api/v1/

title: Anonymous download from gitlab.com
why: /-/archive, /-/raw and release downloads with no credentials are unauthenticated gitlab.com requests.
fix: Use the API route with a token (repository/archive.tar.gz?sha=REF, repository/files/PATH/raw?ref=REF) or the Codeberg archive/raw URL.

title: Submodule URL on gitlab.com over https
why: git submodule update clones it with no credentials on every fresh CI workspace.
fix: url = git@gitlab.com:owner/repo.git, url = https://codeberg.org/owner/repo.git, or an insteadOf rule with a token before git submodule update.

title: gitlab.com package registry without a token
why: The npm/PyPI/Maven package registry lives under /api/v4, so a token-less index URL is an unauthenticated API call per package.

title: Hosted runner shares the 60/hour per-IP allowance
why: GitHub-hosted runners come from shared cloud IP ranges, so the per-IP anonymous allowance is not yours alone.
fix: env: GITLAB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITLAB_TOKEN }} on the job, used by every gitlab.com step, or a self-hosted runner.
